seo.title: Our Story — Eternal Repos
seo.description: Eternal began with a simple truth: no family should have to arrange a farewell alone. This is who we are, and why we exist.

hero.heading: No family should have to say goodbye alone.
hero.paragraph1: When someone dies, a grieving family is suddenly asked to arrange a hundred unfamiliar things — the transport, the papers, the rites, the flowers — often alone, and always in the hardest hour to do them.
hero.paragraph2: Eternal was created to change that: to be the steady presence that carries the practical weight, so a family can simply grieve and be together. The vehicle is our most visible promise of dignity — the care around it is our reason for being.
hero.imageAlt: Eternal Repos ceremonial team supporting a family with reverence and gentle care

pullQuote.quote: “Dignity for the departed, and care for the living, are the same act — not two services.”

vision.heading: A hand to hold, wherever loss is felt.
vision.body: To be the presence families across India trust in their most vulnerable hour — met not with a transaction, but with empathy, calm, and unwavering support.

mission.heading: To carry the weight, so families can grieve.
mission.body: To stand beside families through the whole of the last goodbye — the arrangements, the farewell, and the days after — honouring every faith and tradition, so loved ones can focus only on healing and remembrance.

hands.heading: Built with care, by experienced hands.

items.title: Made by Azimuth
items.description: Eternal is built by Azimuth Business on Wheels, with years of experience crafting specialised vehicles in India — so our promise of dignity is one you can lean on.

items.title: Considered in every detail
items.description: From privacy and calm to gentle handling, every choice is made for the comfort of the family and the dignity of the one they've lost.

items.title: For families & institutions
items.description: A trusted, reliable partner — whether you're a family reaching out at midnight, or a hospital caring for those in your charge.

verse.text: Let life be beautiful like summer flowers, and death like autumn leaves.
